name: cmk-avrora-erp
description: ЦМК АВРОРА — ERP-система планирования производства (frontend + backend monorepo)

scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c magenta,cyan -k "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend run build" "npm --prefix frontend run build"
